name: preset-full
title: Full Preset
description: Stable Constructive full backend preset mapped to its supported Console Kit modules.
docs:
`preset-full` installed all seven Console modules and the stable Full preset component. Render `FullConsoleKit` with a secret-free tenant descriptor.

Degraded states: installed backend modules do not imply public routes or user authority; Storage, Billing, or Notifications can remain partial or unavailable while other modules continue.

Guide: https://constructive-io.github.io/blocks/blocks/console-kit/
